verification_methodology.disclosure: The garden hose is modeled as a 12-segment (1.92 m, 27 mm OD) free-body articulated chain of invisible MuJoCo capsule collision proxies joined by compliant two-axis bending hinges under gravity and Coulomb ground friction on the measured Nova-Wanderland pavement and grass verge. Spot attaches its library arm gripper to the hose lead-end tow collar through a documented compliant spring-damper coupling driven by the live nose_tip site on Spot's catalogue jaw, with zero force applied to any trailing segment; release sets coupling force to 0 N. Optical frames sweep a single continuous NURBS rubber tube (r = 0.0135 m) directly from the 12 recorded link states using the original BEHAVIOR-1K hose/qxgbfv surface maps. Its catalogue mesh is a rigid stored coil. Walkway overlap and horizontal distance from the pedestrian path are measured from simulated link coordinates with zero forced human contact.
